question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Check full result count
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
driver_champs AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON ds.race_id = lry.last_race_id
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
constructor_champs AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON cs.race_id = lry.last_race_id
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, total_points
    FROM (
        SELECT r.year, dr.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(dr.points) as total_points,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(dr.points) DESC) as rn
        FROM results dr
        JOIN races r ON dr.race_id = r.race_id
        JOIN constructors c ON dr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
        WHERE r.year < 1958 AND dr.points IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY r.year, dr.constructor_id, c.name
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    dc.year,
    dc.driver_id,
    dc.forename,
    dc.surname,
    dc.driver_points,
    cc.constructor_id,
    cc.name as constructor_name,
    cc.constructor_points
FROM driver_champs dc
JOIN constructor_champs cc ON dc.year = cc.year
ORDER BY dc.year
